Name: Spurge
Description:
The Spurge is a new desert plant, inspired by the succulent.

Like the succulent, the Forester plants it on dry, clean ground, and it will only germinate there. After 65 days it can be felled for 2 Water. Clean water and green soil are lethal to the plant.

Unlike the succulent, it tolerates contaminated soil and even shallow badwater after germination, and will continue to grow.

It enters the fruiting phase once fully grown. On dry ground, fresh Badwater is ready every 40 days.

During the fruiting phase, photosynthesis is turbocharged by exposure to badwater.

[list]
[*]On contaminated soil, it produces Badwater twice as fast (every 20 days).
[*]In shallow badwater, it produces Badwater four times as fast (every 10 days).
[/list]

The Tapper's Shack taps it for 4 Badwater.
